evidence: log loss +0.0170 (95% interval +0.0081 to +0.0251). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

306 picks, ROI +2.0% (95% interval -6.5% to +10.0%), win rate 60.8% against a break-even 58.9%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 9% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.13 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,830 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,739; a 1% edge takes 43,466. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
